source_text.body:
Fight a mattress warranty claim by email
A user's agent emailed back and forth with the mattress company's agent, citing laws and pushing aggressively, to resolve a warranty claim.
·
Sep 28, 2026
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
User emailed the mattress company about a two-year-old warranty issue and spotted ChatGPT-style replies after one or two exchanges. They then set their own agent to handle the ongoing email thread, giving it instructions to cite laws and respond as an aggressive pain-in-the-ass customer while the company's side stayed polite.
How it went
The agents continued exchanging emails with no resolution or outcome numbers stated in the post.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Cowork
Copy prompt
I have a warranty claim with [company name] for my [product, purchase date, and the defect]. Draft a firm, polite email that cites the warranty terms and any consumer protection laws that apply in [my state or country], and states the remedy I want. Show me the draft before sending anything, and when replies come in, draft each response for my approval until the claim is resolved.
Original source: https://x.com/yosoymario91/status/2104544727928377679
source_text.scope: Captured case text; external linked articles and HTML excluded.
